STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_037004.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_037004.v · Open raw
module origen_037004 (
    input wire i_clk,
    input wire i_rst_n,
    inout wire io_data,
    output reg [15:0] o_temp,
    output reg [15:0] o_humi
);

// Parameters
localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
localparam INIT = 2'b01;
localparam ANS = 2'b10;
localparam RD_DATA = 2'b11;

// Internal signals
reg [1:0] state, next_state;
reg [19:0] cnt_1s;
reg [5:0] cnt_40us;
reg [5:0] data_num;
reg [39:0] get_data;
reg data_en;
reg data_out;
reg [1:0] data_buf;
wire data_pluse;

// Double-flop synchronization
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n)
        data_buf <= 2'b11;
    else
        data_buf <= {data_buf[0], io_data};
end

// Rising edge detector
assign data_pluse = ~data_buf[1] & data_buf[0];

// 1-second counter
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n)
        cnt_1s <= 20'd0;
    else if (cnt_1s == 20'd999_999)
        cnt_1s <= 20'd0;
    else
        cnt_1s <= cnt_1s + 1'b1;
end

// 40μs counter
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n)
        cnt_40us <= 6'd0;
    else if (state == RD_DATA)
        cnt_40us <= (cnt_40us == 6'd39) ? 6'd0 : cnt_40us + 1'b1;
    else
        cnt_40us <= 6'd0;
end

// State machine
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n)
        state <= IDLE;
    else
        state <= next_state;
end

always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        IDLE: next_state = (cnt_1s == 20'd999_999) ? INIT : IDLE;
        INIT: next_state = (cnt_1s == 20'd1_000) ? ANS : INIT;
        ANS: next_state = data_pluse ? RD_DATA : ANS;
        RD_DATA: next_state = (data_num == 6'd40) ? IDLE : RD_DATA;
        default: next_state = IDLE;
    endcase
end

// Data reading
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n) begin
        data_num <= 6'd0;
        get_data <= 40'd0;
    end else if (state == RD_DATA) begin
        if (cnt_40us == 6'd39) begin
            data_num <= data_num + 1'b1;
            get_data <= {get_data[38:0], (cnt_40us > 6'd22) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0};
        end
    end else begin
        data_num <= 6'd0;
    end
end

// Output data
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n) begin
        o_humi <= 16'd0;
        o_temp <= 16'd0;
    end else if (state == IDLE && next_state == INIT) begin
        o_humi <= {get_data[39:32], get_data[31:24]};
        o_temp <= {get_data[23:16], get_data[15:8]};
    end
end

// Bidirectional data line control
always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n) begin
    if (!i_rst_n) begin
        data_en <= 1'b0;
        data_out <= 1'b1;
    end else if (state == INIT) begin
        data_en <= 1'b1;
        data_out <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        data_en <= 1'b0;
        data_out <= 1'b1;
    end
end

assign io_data = data_en ? data_out : 1'bz;

endmodule
